name: LMDeploy spec mean accept-length gauge
notes: InternLM/lmdeploy main, PrometheusStatLogger in lmdeploy/metrics/loggers.py, read 2026-10-04. On by default and requires NO flag: the endpoint is simply available at the API server port (23333 by default). Label keys are model_name and engine on every metric, where engine carries the dp_rank. Bucket construction reuses vLLM's build_buckets / build_1_2_5_buckets idiom. Unusual: LMDeploy ships the DERIVED acceptance ratios as first-class gauges (mean_accept_rate = accepted/draft_tokens, mean_accept_length = 1 + accepted/drafts) rather than leaving the division to PromQL as vLLM does. The raw counters are present too, so the ratios are auditable.
